name: 크림색 벽면
prompt: ONE horizontal repeatable wall-surface texture panel matching the room's upper walls. FLAT FRONT ELEVATION: straight rectangular 2:1 landscape panel. Surface fills the ENTIRE canvas edge to edge, no padding. Upper 76 percent is plain warm cream #EEE8D3, bottom 19 percent is muted sage-green painted dado/baseboard band #8A9A73, bottom 5 percent is a thin honey-oak skirting strip. Two subtle flat shade steps only, crisp horizontal boundaries, NO grain/patina/cracks/painterly noise. The left and right edges must match for horizontal repetition. No top timber, vertical beam, frame, window, furniture, words, logo, shadows or magenta. This is a simple wall material module, not a whole room.
